title: 1987 Topps Garbage Pail Kids #256a Jack Pot Sticker Card
descriptionText: The 1987 Topps Garbage Pail Kids #256a JACK POT trading card is a vintage collectible from the original 1980s set. Featuring the character Tiger of Happiness, this standard-sized card is made of card stock with a thickness of 35 Pt. Produced by Topps, the card is an original non-sport trading card in English language. It is part of the Garbage Pail Kids franchise and includes a sticker feature, making it a sought-after item for collectors of comedy and comics memorabilia.
